entries.name: On the robustness of topological gap detection via transport
entries.text: on the robustness of topological gap detection via transport paper quantum_technology topological-qubit majorana-zero-modes peer-review matters-arising identifies coding errors in the topological gap protocol (tgp) analysis code, including a hardcoded filter that displayed only the single largest favorable data region the challenged authors (microsoft azure quantum) published a rebuttal in the same nature issue disputing the significance of the identified issues topological-gap-protocol nature-638-651-655-2025

entries.name: Interferometric single-shot parity measurement in InAs-Al hybrid devices
entries.text: interferometric single-shot parity measurement in inas-al hybrid devices paper quantum_technology topological-qubit majorana-zero-modes quantum-computing superconductor-semiconductor-hybrid a formal 'matters arising' challenge was published in nature (24 june 2026) disputing the validity of the topological gap protocol used to support the paper's central claim the paper's editorial note states the results do not by themselves constitute evidence for majorana zero modes, only for the device architecture indium-arsenide-aluminum-heterostructure topological-gap-protocol superconducting-nanowire
